title: Unit registry
description: One record per unit the corpus uses. A unit is looked up by its QUDT IRI. Its dimension is the SI Brochure's dimensional product; its factor to the coherent SI unit is exact where the defining documents make it exact, and says so where a decimal cannot be.

id.description: QUDT IRI, prefixed: "unit:M". Checked to resolve at qudt.org when the record was written.

name.description: The unit's name as its defining document spells it.

symbol.description: The corpus's readable form, the one a parameter's quantity.symbol must equal: "m", "m^2", "deg", "1".

ucum.description: The unit as a UCUM code, case-sensitive, in the form a person would write: division by the solidus (UCUM 2.2 section 7), so "kg/m3" and "m/s". Unique across the registry, so a consumer may write it and mean one unit.

ucum_qudt.description: The code QUDT records (qudt:ucumCode), verbatim, present exactly when it is spelled differently from ucum: "kg.m-3" beside "kg/m3". An equal UCUM term, kept so a consumer holding QUDT's spelling can find the unit. Never the code the corpus writes.

quantity_kinds.description: The kinds of quantity this unit may measure in this corpus. Dimension alone cannot tell an angle from a ratio or a torque from an energy; the kind can.

dimension.description: Dimensional exponents over the seven SI base quantities, in the SI Brochure's order and symbols (Table 3): time, length, mass, electric current, thermodynamic temperature, amount of substance, luminous intensity. All zero for a quantity with the unit one, which includes plane angle.

si_coherent.description: True when the unit is a base unit or a coherent derived unit of the SI. A consumer that is SI inside writes only these.

unit.description: The coherent SI unit of the same dimension. Must be a record with si_coherent true.

factor.description: Multiply a value in this unit by this to get the coherent SI unit. A decimal string, so that no reader rounds it on the way in.

exact.description: True when the decimal in factor is the exact value. False when the exact value is not a finite decimal; expression then carries it.

expression.description: The exact value as arithmetic, where factor cannot hold it: "pi/180", "1852/3600".

basis.description: What makes the factor what it is, and where that was read.

to_coherent_si.description: Required exactly when si_coherent is false.

edition.description: The edition and version read. An undated citation is not reproducible.
